meta.keyedBy: cvegeo (INEGI AGEB key, same as /labs/shared/infra/ageb-profile.geojson id)
meta.method: AGEB polygons rasterized on 25 m block centres (blocks of the 5 m grid). Very small AGEBs may get few blocks; null = no block centre inside.

fields.blocks25m: number of 25 m blocks (625 m2) whose centre lies in the AGEB
fields.susc_mean: mean susceptibility score (0-1 percentile among urban blocks of the AOI) over scored blocks
fields.susc_p90: 90th percentile of the score inside the AGEB
fields.susc_alta_pct: % of scored blocks with score >= 0.80 (class alta)
fields.susc_scored_pct: % of blocks inside the urban-fabric mask that carries a score
fields.dep_n: depression patches (fill depth >= 10 cm, building-aware DEM, open ground) with centroid in the AGEB
fields.dep_n_ge30cm: of those, patches deeper than 30 cm
fields.dep_vol_m3: their total fill volume (m3) = static ponding capacity before spilling
fields.dep_max_m: deepest patch (m); > 5 m are usually quarries/excavations
fields.fill_vol_all_m3: all fill volume on open ground including < 10 cm micro-depressions
fields.hand_lt1_pct: % of AGEB area (5 m cells) less than 1 m above its drainage line (streams >= 1 km2 upslope)
fields.slope175_mean_pct: mean terrain slope over ~175 m windows (%), i.e. flatness
